title: CircuitForge circuit
description: Electrical topology plus teaching material. Layout and wiring are computed from the graph; positions, rotations and wire routes are optional overrides. See docs/JSON-SCHEMA.md and examples/complete-circuit.json.

version.description: Version of this circuit document (free form).

description.description: One paragraph about the circuit; not drawn.

metadata.description: Bookkeeping: author, revision, course, tags, licence. Never affects the drawing.

layout.description: Spacing for the automatic layout. All values are in schematic pixels.

grid.description: Placement grid; rounded to a multiple of the 10px routing grid.

componentGap.description: Horizontal gap between columns; grows automatically where many nets cross.

labelGap.description: Gap between a part and its reference/value text.

sectionGap.description: Gap between sub-circuits that are only joined through rails.

direction.description: Reserved; signal flow is left to right.

supplyVoltage.description: Used by rules that need a supply figure (LED resistor sizing, resistor power).

rules.description: Severity per rule code: off | info | warning | error.

simulation.description: Metadata for an external simulator. CircuitForge stores and validates it but does not simulate.

expected.description: Expected results, for teaching and for checking your own measurements.

education.description: Teaching material for the circuit as a whole; shown in the app's Learn panel.

id.description: Unique reference designator, e.g. R1. No dots or spaces.

type.description: Component type or alias (resistor, npn, opamp, timer_555, arduino_uno, ground, …).

value.description: Shown next to the part. For ground/vcc/net_label it names the rail.

label.description: Display name instead of the id; for box parts it is the text inside the box.

rotation.description: Clockwise degrees. Rotates the drawing and the pin coordinates together. Omit for automatic orientation.

position.description: Canvas coordinates of the part's first pin. Omit for automatic placement.

section.description: Puts the part in the left, middle or right band of the sheet.

pins.description: Box parts only (generic_ic, microcontroller, memory, connector, boards…): the pins to draw.

pinTypes.description: Electrical type per pin, used by the rule checks.

params.description: Physical data: tolerance, ratings, package/footprint. Rules such as RESISTOR_POWER read from here.

education.description: Notes for this part: purpose, explanation, mistakes.

simulation.description: Per-part simulation data, e.g. a model name.

connections.description: Each entry joins two or more pins into one net. Pin references are "ComponentId.pin"; single-pin parts may be referenced without a pin.

net.description: Net name; nets with the same name are joined.

waypoints.description: Points the router must pass through.

route.description: Manual orthogonal route, drawn as given.

locked.description: Keep this route when parts move.

junctions.description: Informational. Junction dots are detected automatically wherever three or more wire ends meet.

measurements.description: Probe markers drawn on the schematic.

at.description: Net name, "Component.pin", component id, or {x, y}.

annotations.description: Free text with a leader line.

at.description: Net name, "Component.pin", component id, or {x, y}.

bom.description: Bill of materials rows. Free form; per-part data can also live on the component.

points.description: Points as [{"x":120,"y":80}] or [[120,80]]; snapped to the 10px grid.
